name: hud_numbers_two_decimals
description: Every number on a tooltip or a plate shows at most two decimals, none it does not need (playtest halv s2, P10, f48639 and f49774: the Queen's Guard's fork tooltip and plate read 'cooldown 0.8s to 1.43333333333333s'). The Queen's Guard fires every 86 ticks, 1.4333 s; one formatter, Game.num, now says every tower and creep number: the branch tooltip's from-to numbers ('Damage 18 to 54 · cooldown 0.8s to 1.43s'), the selected tower's plate (Cooldown 1.43s), the Builders screen's kit tip (Game.kit_tip) and a creep's plate (Speed). Without the fix the tooltip and the plate printed the float as it came, '1.43333333333333s' and 'Damage 18.0 to 54.0'.

steps.msg: at most two decimals, trailing zeros dropped

steps.assert: node('Tooltip').visible and node('TooltipBody').text.begins_with('Damage 18 to 54 · cooldown 0.8s to 1.43s · pierce 0 to 4')
steps.msg: the Queen's Guard's fork: its cooldown to two decimals
the forked Queen's Guard's plate: Cooldown 1.43s
the kit tips through the same numbers
a Thornback's plate: its speed of 0.85 tiles a second, no longer rounded to 0.8
